description: This file defines the FileNotReadableException class in the ZipStream\Exception namespace, which extends a general Exception class and is used when a file isn't readable.

classes.name: FileNotReadableException
classes.description: An exception thrown when a file isn't readable, extends the base Exception class, and provides detailed error messaging including the problematic file path.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a message indicating that the specified file path isn't readable.
